title: RunSpan

RunSpan.description: One span of a run's trace.

attributes.description: What it was, with OpenTelemetry's names where they have one (`host.id`, `container.id`) and `reeval.`'s otherwise.

links.description: Spans it relates to outside its parent: a lease's machine.
